summary: Write concrete, evidence-backed product content for a real audience without process narration, leakage, or AI slop.

outcomes: Turn authoritative product facts into concise audience-directed content.
Remove unsupported claims, generic filler, repetition, and private context leakage.

scenarios.title: Rewrite product documentation
scenarios.prompt: Use $write-product-content to revise this documentation for developers while preserving its approved structure and presentation.
scenarios.outcome: The content leads with developer outcomes, uses verified commands, and removes process-centered filler.

scenarios.prompt: Use $write-product-content to turn these verified release facts into concise consumer-facing copy.
scenarios.outcome: The release text states concrete user impact without commit narration or unsupported significance.
